name: A Lost Master
summary: In Auberdine, Terenthis prepares a way to search for Volcor, missing in Darkshore. He can weave a cloak of camouflage, but first needs pelts from the coast's fiercest moonstalkers.

sections.title: A Search into the Wilds
sections.body: In Auberdine, Terenthis fears for Volcor and his companion Grimclaw as danger closes around Darkshore's coast. Aggressive predators and corrupted wildlife roam the southern wilds. Terenthis will not send an unprotected scout into that danger, so he plans a cloak woven with wild illusions.

sections.title: Pelts of the Pride
sections.body: Ordinary hides cannot fool Darkshore's beasts. Terenthis needs fine pelts from mature moonstalker sires or matriarchs. The great cats roam the woodlands south of Auberdine, near the Wildbend River and toward Ashenvale's forested border.

sections.title: Delicate Magic
sections.body: Moonstalker fur and nature enchantments let the wearer pass through hostile territory while searching for Volcor. Terenthis warns that the illusion is delicate. Strenuous activity or combat breaks the enchantment and leaves the searcher exposed.

faq.answer: Volcor is a night elf scout or tracker missing in the wilds of southern Darkshore. His companion Grimclaw and Terenthis in Auberdine seek to find him.

aliases: where to get a lost master
faq.answer: Terenthis, a night elf in Auberdine, offers to make the cloak after adventurers help with earlier local concerns.

faq.q: Where are moonstalker sires and matriarchs found?
faq.answer: Mature moonstalker sires and matriarchs roam southern Darkshore, near the Wildbend River and farther south toward the Ashenvale border.

faq.q: What is the cloak meant to do?
faq.answer: Terenthis plans to enchant a cloak that conceals its wearer from Darkshore's hostile beasts, allowing a search for Volcor without constantly drawing attacks.

faq.q: Why does Terenthis need specific pelts?
faq.answer: Terenthis needs five fine pelts from moonstalker sires or matriarchs to make the cloak.

faq.q: Does the camouflage cloak have limitations?
faq.answer: Yes. Terenthis warns that the enchantment is fragile. Speaking to others is permitted, but strenuous activity or combat quickly breaks the illusion.

angles.text: As a night elf, finding Volcor reflects your duty to protect your kindred and wild companions across Darkshore.
As a hunter, you know the bond between Volcor and Grimclaw, and the skill it takes to track and hunt Darkshore's matriarchs and sires.
As a druid, you can appreciate how Terenthis turns moonstalkers' wild essence into protective camouflage.
